acceptance: A test-amplification run that adds tests yields amplify.tests_added in the routing digest (red test first)
mutation-gate is admissible after such a run in a routing replay
fix: TDD first. Give each phase that declares outputs.signals one writer: the runner extracts the declared signals from the phase's report sentinel or a named handoff file and writes handoff-<phase>.json, or the persona names the file and the build floor checks it. A declaration with no runtime writer is then a validation error. 100% coverage, zero comments, update internal-router.md and the persona.
summary: Filed from the independent review of PR #1105 (M3, 2026-10-21). router.foldHandoffSignals reads handoff-<phase>.json for any completed non-spine phase, and phasespec.UnproducedTriggerFields counts a declared outputs.signals entry as a producer. But no runtime code writes handoff-<phase>.json for a non-spine phase (the only handoff- writer is the pair handoffs, core/handoff_reviewer.go:74), and the test-amplification persona (agents/evolve-test-amplification.md:44-46) says to set namespaced signals without naming a file. test-amplification ran 10 times in the real runs and no handoff-test-amplification.json exists. So mutation-gate (trigger amplify.tests_added) is still unreachable at runtime.
title: Declared phase output signals never reach routing: no runtime writes handoff-<phase>.json for a non-spine phase
